name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – After § 51 – Am 10
title: REPORT on a revamped long-term budget for the Union in a changing world
part_text: 51a. Recalls that, in accordance with Article 168 TFEU, health policy falls within the competence of the Member States, particularly with regard to the organisation and delivery of health services; considers that the next MFF should not serve as a pretext for a recentralisation of competences in the area of health; considers that the Union’s role must be limited to coordination, support and complementarity, and that any EU funding in this field must strictly respect the division of competences laid down in the Treaties;
